entities.summary: Charles Edward Clark Jr. is an American professional football safety for the Detroit Lions of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Virginia Tech Hokies. Clark was selected by the Baltimore Ravens in the sixth round of the 2017 NFL draft. Clark has also played for the New York Jets and Pittsburgh Steelers.
